windows.reason:
The obstacle is the operating system toolchain, not the GPU. QUICK is a mixed Fortran/HIP build: .f90 modules compiled by gfortran, linked against rocBLAS/rocSOLVER Fortran bindings. There is no MSVC-ABI Fortran compiler available, so the Fortran half of the build cannot be produced in the ABI the rest of the Windows toolchain uses; this is a language-toolchain gap on the platform, not something the port can fix. Confirmed on windows-gfx1101 and windows-gfx1201. NOTE for the approver: approving this alone does NOT make QUICK PR-ready -- wave64 is also unsatisfied at head 
 and still needs a gfx90a or gfx942 run. This suggestion only removes the windows gate from that list.

carry_forward.detail: Delta 1bedbbb..d369e07 is a single additive gfx1100 elseif branch in QUICKCudaConfig.cmake never taken for QUICK_USER_ARCH=gfx90a; built both shas from the same src checkout into build_old/build_new,

windows-gfx1101.blocked_reason: Windows host has no MSVC-ABI Fortran compiler; QUICK is a mixed Fortran/HIP build (.f90 modules, gfortran, rocBLAS/rocSOLVER Fortran bindings) -- not buildable on Windows.

windows-gfx1201.blocked_reason: Windows host has no MSVC-ABI Fortran compiler; QUICK is a mixed Fortran/HIP build (.f90 modules, gfortran, rocBLAS/rocSOLVER Fortran bindings) -- not buildable on Windows.

windows-gfx1151.blocked_reason: No usable Fortran compiler on Windows, verified directly on this host rather than assumed. QUICK is a mixed Fortran/HIP build whose .f90 modules must link against the HIP/clang-cl side, so it needs an MSVC-ABI Fortran compiler. TheRock's Windows ROCm SDK ships lib/llvm/bin/flang.exe and amdflang.exe advertising 'AMD flang version 23.0.0git / Target: x86_64-pc-windows-msvc', which looks like exactly that -- but they are not Flang. Verified 2026-08-20: flang.exe is BYTE-IDENTICAL to clang.exe (md5 4146b241ae49296481b7bb54db9a7da2, 108,242,944 bytes both); 'flang.exe -fc1 -help' prints 'OVERVIEW: clang LLVM compiler' and rejects -fc1 as an unknown argument; compiling a four-line .f90 fails because the driver spawns itself with frontend flags it cannot parse; and no flang_rt runtime libraries and no Fortran .mod files (iso_fortran_env, __fortran_builtins) are packaged anywhere under the SDK. Registered as ROCm packaging bug report therock-windows-flang-is-clang. Scope note, stated plainly: NO build was attempted on this host, because the Fortran prerequisite was checked first and is absent, so the Fortran half could not have compiled. NOT necessarily a permanent platform limit: Intel ifx (oneAPI Fortran) targets the MSVC ABI and interoperates with MSVC-ABI C/C++ objects, and nobody has tried it -- that is the open question the suggested windows waiver should be judged against. Note wave64 is ALSO unsatisfied at head, so windows is not the only gate outstanding here.
